provisionalNote: PROVISIONAL. Every constant swept here is class ASSUME and none has been measured (PARAMETERS.md §10, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md phase gate). A row whose rangeSource is "inferred" is being swept across a range this project invented (A-04): its swing is a statement about our invention, not about a projector.
